title: (RHEA-2016:2840) Fuse Integration Services 2.0 Technical Preview
portal_summary:
This errata is for a Technical Preview of Fuse Integration Services 2.0. 

This is not a supported release and both the documentation and the product are liable to change between now and the GA release.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.3|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en/red-hat-xpaas/0/single/red-hat-jboss-fuse-integration-services-20-for-openshift/
portal_description: Red Hat JBoss Fuse Integration Services provides a set of tools and containerized xPaaS images that enable development, deployment, and management of integration microservices within OpenShift.
abstract: Red Hat JBoss Fuse Integration Services provides a set of tools and containerized xPaaS images that enable development, deployment, and management of integration microservices within OpenShift.
